create_simple_cpu_offload_worker: create a SimpleCPUOffloadWorker instance with vllm config, kv cache config, and cpu capacity in bytes
register_kv_caches: register gpu kv caches and allocate pinned cpu tensors for cpu offloading transfers
build_connector_worker_meta: build connector worker metadata with completed store events since the last call
run_get_finished: run get_finished to submit kv cache transfers and report completed load events to the scheduler
handle_preemptions: handle preemptions by synchronizing all in-flight transfers before preempted blocks are reused
